observations: Industrial sewing machine with a digital control panel.
Brand 'Nanbang' is visible on the front panel and the model 'N89F JD' is printed on the side.
The machine is mounted on a white metal table.
A foot pedal is visible at the front of the table.
The machine appears to be in a warehouse or shop environment with other fabrics in the background.
The digital display is off in the photo.

claims.evidence: The machine is shown in a warehouse, but the interior and underside are not visible.
Strength is a subjective mechanical property that cannot be verified through photos.
The seller cannot prove the origin or the specific 'Belgium' claim.
The drive mechanism is not visible in the photo.
The machine is not shown powered on or in operation.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and the needle moving through the fabric.

risks.risk: The digital display may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the display powered on showing the menu and time.

risks.risk: The machine may have mechanical wear or internal damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full mechanical overhaul

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and sewing fabric.
Photo of the digital display while the machine is running.
Photo of the underside of the machine to check for rust or wear.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
